errors.text: The material is not identified as as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic high-entropy alloy containing FCC and B2 phases; it is incorrectly framed as an as-quenched supersaturated alloy without long-range order.

The proposed transition is primarily aging-time-dependent at one temperature, whereas the target transition is aging-temperature-dependent, with maximum embrittlement near 600°C and recovery near 750°C.
The hypothesis lacks prior evidence for enhanced L12 ordering toward Ni3Al stoichiometry and for jagged B2/FCC phase-boundary evolution.
The proposed experiment does not test crack initiation and dislocation pile-ups at jagged phase-boundary tips or exclude impurity-segregation-driven intergranular embrittlement.
